name: Metal Rage
summary: Metal Rage is a mecha-themed third-person shooter online game set in 2070, where three major factions clash over cosmic supremacy. Players can choose from eight different mechs with distinct roles, including heavy defense, engineer, long-range support, and high-mobility reconnaissance types, and engage in tactical cooperation through combinations of their unique mech abilities. The core gameplay revolves around teamwork, offering modes such as target destruction, stronghold attack and defense, and resource competition, as well as a dedicated escort/boss interception mode. The combat system combines strategic deployment with real-time controls, utilizing realistic maps, physical feedback, and weapon vibrations to enhance immersion while simplifying controls for a wider player base.
